reading.title: Climate Change and Biodiversity
reading.passage: Climate change represents one of the most significant threats to global biodiversity. Rising temperatures alter ecosystems, forcing species to migrate or adapt rapidly. Coral reefs, rainforests, and polar regions face unprecedented pressure. Scientists warn that without immediate action, we could lose up to 50% of species by 2100. Conservation efforts and renewable energy adoption are essential strategies to mitigate these impacts and preserve Earth's biological diversity for future generations.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is the main threat to global biodiversity?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'Climate change represents one of the most significant threats to global biodiversity'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: Which ecosystems are mentioned as facing unprecedented pressure?
options: C) Coral reefs, rainforests, and polar regions
questions.explanation: 본문의 'Coral reefs, rainforests, and polar regions face unprecedented pressure'에서 답을 찾을 수 있습니다.

questions.q: What is suggested as an essential strategy to mitigate climate change impacts?
options: B) Conservation efforts and renewable energy adoption
questions.explanation: 'Conservation efforts and renewable energy adoption are essential strategies'라는 문장에서 정답을 확인할 수 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Remote work should be the primary work model for all companies'?

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표현: 동의 또는 반대 의견을 직접 서술하고, 2-3가지 주요 이유를 미리 언급합니다.
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주요 이유와 구체적 예시 제시: 원격근무의 장점(유연성, 비용절감) 또는 단점(소통 어려움, 업무 감시)을 구체적으로 설명합니다.
structure.body2: 두 번째 주요 이유와 근거 제시: 기업의 생산성, 직원 만족도, 또는 특정 산업의 특수성 등을 논증합니다.
structure.conclusion: 앞서 제시한 주요 이유들을 요약하고, 최종 입장을 재강조하며 미래 전망을 제시합니다.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer working in an office environment with colleagues. Others prefer working remotely from home. Which work environment do you prefer and why?
sample_points: 사무실 근무의 장점: 동료와의 직접 소통, 팀 협업 강화, 일-생활 구분이 명확함. 예시: 회의나 브레인스토밍이 더 효과적입니다.
원격근무의 장점: 출퇴근 시간 절감, 개인 환경에서의 집중력 향상, 시간 활용의 자유도. 예시: 아침시간을 가족과 함께 보낼 수 있고 점심시간도 유연하게 조정할 수 있습니다.

listening.title: 대학 도서관 오리엔테이션
listening.script: Librarian: Welcome to our university library. I'm happy to help you get oriented. Student: Thank you. This is my first time here, and I'm a bit overwhelmed by the size. Librarian: That's completely normal. Let me give you a quick overview. We have five floors. The first floor has our circulation desk and computers for catalog searches. The second and third floors contain our main book collection organized by the Dewey Decimal System. The fourth floor is dedicated to journals, databases, and research materials. Finally, the fifth floor has quiet study areas and private research rooms available by reservation. Student: Wow, that's helpful. How do I access online databases? Librarian: You can access them from any computer on campus using your student ID. We also have a mobile app that provides 24-hour access from anywhere. Many students find this very convenient for researching from home. Student: Excellent. One more question—are there any workshops available for research skills? Librarian: Yes, we offer free workshops every Wednesday at 3 PM covering topics like advanced search techniques and citation management. I highly recommend attending at least one.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: B) To introduce a new student to library facilities and services
C) To schedule a research appointment
D) To solve a book cataloging problem
questions.explanation: 사서가 새로운 학생을 위해 도서관 시설과 서비스를 소개하고 있습니다. 이것이 대화의 주된 목적입니다.

questions.q: On which floor can students find quiet study areas and private research rooms?
questions.explanation: 사서의 설명에서 'Finally, the fifth floor has quiet study areas and private research rooms available by reservation'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: How often are research skills workshops offered?
questions.explanation: 사서가 'we offer free workshops every Wednesday at 3 PM'이라고 언급했습니다.
